# vincentlarkin.com

> Personal website for Vincent Larkin, featuring his professional profile, projects, photo gallery, site updates, and a curated article archive.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://vincentlarkin.com/): Project highlights, recent site notes, featured topics, contact links, and the latest monthly image.
- [About](https://vincentlarkin.com/about.html): Professional profile, skills, location, and contact information.
- [News / Books](https://vincentlarkin.com/news.html): Curated article archive and bookshelf.
- [Gallery](https://vincentlarkin.com/gallery.html): Monthly photo gallery and visual archive.
- [Changelog](https://vincentlarkin.com/changelog.html): Recent updates pulled from the site's public GitHub history.
- [Privacy Policy](https://vincentlarkin.com/privacy.html): Details about hosting logs, local storage, and third-party services.
